resources.string: Humane, non-judgmental sleep guidance. Open the Sleep AI tab to chat anytime. It works on this device with no setup.

Add your own Google Gemini API key for fuller answers and for AI-written reading passages. With a key, the messages you send the counselor and your passage requests are sent to Google using that key. Without one, nothing leaves your device.
A key is saved on this device.
AlarmBoss never asks for photos of your home and never records audio while you sleep:
🛡️ No home photos: no pictures of your living space are captured or stored.
🎙️ No nighttime audio: the microphone is only used for voice answers you choose to give.
📱 On-device processing: barcode scans and pose detection run on the phone.
🌐 The only online feature is the optional counselor key above; it is off until you add one.
AI Generate adds new passages to your list. It needs a Gemini key (see the counselor card).
Couldn\'t reach the AI. Check your connection and key. Your passages were not changed.
